definitions.explanation: The two-fingers-extended hand shape in the game janken, which beats paper (パー) and loses to rock (グー). The shape resembles a pair of scissors.

examples.japanese: チョキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧とき、⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧チョキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ポーズ→ポーズ：11268_poozu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When taking the photo, I made a scissors shape with my fingers and posed.

notes:
One of the three hand shapes in ⟦じゃんけん→じゃんけん：06520_janken⟧ (rock-paper-scissors), together with ⟦グー→グー：29915_guu⟧ (rock) and ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧ (paper). チョキ extends two fingers; it beats ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧ and loses to ⟦グー→グー：29915_guu⟧. The same shape doubles as the "peace sign" in photos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チョキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to throw scissors
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧チョキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a scissors shape with the fingers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦グー→グー：29915_guu⟧: rock — the clenched-fist shape
- ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧: paper — the open-hand shape
